title: Cloudflare
description: Cloudflare v4 API over REST (API token) — Production DNS and Workers

credential.label: Cloudflare API token
credential.description: A scoped API token (user or account token), not a Global API Key. Grant only the permissions this connector needs, on only the accounts and zones it serves. It is sent only to api.cloudflare.com, stored encrypted, and never displayed.

guide.summary: Configured Cloudflare REST credential: resolve domain/account ids, then inspect DNS, Workers, R2, KV or analytics.
guide.content:
# Cloudflare usage

Connector purpose: Production DNS and Workers

This connection already has an operator-configured scoped API token; there is no sign-in step.

No additional deployment pin: the credential's vendor permissions define its reachable estate.

## Accounts, domains and records

Resolve account and zone ids before acting. A zone is a domain, found by its name;
its account id joins it to the account inventory. Cloudflare ids are normally
32-character hex strings. A default id routes a request; a pin limits its scope.

DNS TTL is in seconds; TTL 1 means automatic. Read the record before changing it.
PATCH changes supplied fields; PUT replaces the record, so preserve its type,
name and content. Read state before replacing, rolling back or purging. Prefer
a targeted cache purge by files, tags, hosts or prefixes over purging everything.

Hatch data keeps Cloudflare's vendor envelope. For example, select DNS record
identities with `fields: ["result.id", "result.name"]`; a list stays under
`data.result`. Named account and zone lists keep projected rows with camelCase
account and name-server fields.

## Workers, storage and analytics

Worker script source is code; secret binding values are separate and unavailable.
KV values are application data. Encode a slash inside a KV key or R2 object key
as `%2F`. R2 requires API-token authentication, rather than a Global API Key.

GraphQL Analytics uses accountTag and zoneTag for account/zone identities.
Filter every accounts/zones field by equality or an explicit set of those ids.
A pinned query uses one operation per document and every declared fragment.
Analytics Engine SQL is read-only; D1 SQL and Durable Object queries can write.
AI inference, previews and outbound checks can cost money or activate work.

## Disqualifiers and recovery

Credential minting, rotation, stored secrets, private session captures and signed
upload or deployment links are unavailable. Use the Cloudflare dashboard for
credential administration. A Global API Key cannot change user settings or
memberships through this connection.

After an authentication failure, use `verify_credential` once to distinguish a
rejected credential from a permission gap. An operator replaces the credential;
repeating the failed request does not add permissions. Cloudflare's global limit
counts dashboard traffic and all tokens together, so reduce requests as well as
honoring the returned wait.

## Conventions

- **Paging:** while `page.hasMore` is true, continue with `page.nextCursor` unchanged. For `cloudflare_api_details`, `cloudflare_api_search`, `list_accounts`, `list_zones`, pass it as the top-level `cursor`; omit raw paging anchors on continuations. For `cloudflare_api_read`, put it in `query[page.param]` or `body[page.param]`, as `page.in` specifies. Keep the original method, path, filters, page size, fields and headers. Paged `list_*` and `search_*` reads take `limit` (default 20, at most 50). The last page has no `nextCursor`. If `page.hasMore` is true without a cursor, the data is incomplete and continuation was withheld. When approaching execute_code's per-program call limit, return page.nextCursor before the call that would exceed it and continue in the next program; don't restart.
- **Results:** `fields` narrows a read's result to the dot paths you name. `truncated` lists the dot paths a result cut for size; the ids that fetch what was cut stay in the result.
- **Envelope fields:** hatch data keeps the vendor envelope. Select declared fields with `fields: ["result.id", "result.name"]`; array traversal also accepts `result[].id`. Named reads keep their projected fields.
- **Hatch:** `cloudflare_api_search` finds this API's operations and reads no account data, `cloudflare_api_details` shows one operation's contract, and `cloudflare_api_read` calls a reviewed read. `cloudflare_api_write` calls a reviewed write; the host may ask the user to confirm it. An operation without a reviewed verdict is refused. 70 operations are refused by design; use `cloudflare_api_details` with the method and path to inspect an operation's contract and refusal.
- **Writes:** a write is sent once and never retried. When its outcome is unknown, read the target before repeating it. Writes take no idempotency key.
- **Errors:** codes come from the vendor's statuses and error facts, never its prose. `not_found` means the record does not exist; this API tells absence from a permission gap. It documents no conflict.
- **Withheld values:** a value withheld for safety reads `"[redacted]"`. Writes refuse whole marker values and withheld links; longer prose may mention the marker. Paths and queries refuse any containment.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List Cloudflare accounts by name; only pinned accounts. Resolves account ids for zones, Workers, KV and R2.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous page. Pass it back unchanged.

fields.description: Dot paths to keep in each item, e.g. ["id"]. It only narrows the result.

tools.name: list_zones
tools.description: List Cloudflare zones (domains) by name, status or account; only pinned zones. Resolves domain names to zone/account ids for DNS, cache and analytics.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous page. Pass it back unchanged.

fields.description: Dot paths to keep in each item, e.g. ["id"]. It only narrows the result.

tools.name: verify_credential
tools.description: Verify the configured Cloudflare credential and report its status. Call this first when another call fails with auth_required.

fields.description: Dot paths to keep in the result, e.g. ["auth"]. It only narrows the result.

tools.name: graphql_query
tools.description: Run a read-only GraphQL Analytics API query (POST /graphql). Mutations and subscriptions are refused before sending; filter by zoneTag or accountTag.

variables.description: Variables the query declares, as JSON.

operationName.description: Which query to run when the document has several.

fields.description: Dot paths to keep in the result, e.g. ["data"]. It only narrows the result.

errors.description: GraphQL errors, when Cloudflare returned partial data.

tools.name: cloudflare_api_upload
tools.description: Upload text, base64 bytes, or multipart parts to a reviewed Cloudflare upload operation. Covers Workers scripts, KV values, R2 objects, Pages, Images, Stream, DNS import, and Snippets; never reads local files.

path.description: Concrete path from cloudflare_api_search; encode a / inside an R2 or KV key as %2F.

query.description: Query parameters as JSON, named as details lists them.

cf-r2-jurisdiction.description: R2 only: default, eu, us, fedramp, or fedramp-high, for a bucket outside the default jurisdiction.

contentType.description: Content-Type of a text or base64 body.

textBody.description: A UTF-8 body; exclusive with base64Body and parts.

base64Body.description: Body bytes as base64; exclusive with textBody and parts.

parts.description: multipart/form-data parts; a part with fileName is sent as a file.

base64.description: Bytes as base64; exclusive with text.

fileName.description: Send as a file with this name.

data.description: Cloudflare's response envelope after value safety: result, errors, messages, success.

tools.name: cloudflare_api_search
tools.description: Find Cloudflare API operations by keyword or path. Returns up to 8 compact matches with the tool that calls each; reads no account data.

query.description: Keywords or a path, e.g. refund charge.

cursor.description: page.nextCursor from the previous search with the same query.

tool.description: The tool that calls it; absent when refused.

named.description: A named tool serving this operation with a projected result; prefer it.

matched.description: The request or response field this operation was found by; call its tool to read the field.

truncated.description: Entry labels cut for size; cloudflare_api_details on that method and path returns them whole.

tools.name: cloudflare_api_details
tools.description: Read one Cloudflare API operation's request contract: path, query and body parameters with types and required names. Reads no account data.

path.description: The path template from search, or a concrete path.

param.description: Return only this parameter, in full.

cursor.description: page.nextCursor from the previous details call with the same method, path and param.

body.description: Body content type and schema. When paged: this page's properties, the required names it delivers or chunks, and the schema's other keywords on the page that carries them.

tool.description: The tool that calls it; absent when refused.

named.description: A named tool serving this operation with a projected result; prefer it.

of.description: The piece this text belongs to, such as parameters.limit.

text.description: Part of that piece's JSON; join the parts in page order, then parse them.

truncated.description: Labels cut for size; their full text arrives as chunks.

page.description: Present when the contract exceeds one answer: pass nextCursor back for the next pieces.

tools.name: cloudflare_api_read
tools.description: Call a reviewed Cloudflare API read, including reviewed read-only POST. The operation index checks arguments before anything is sent. DNS records, zones, Workers scripts, R2 buckets and objects, KV namespaces and keys are covered. Data retains the Cloudflare envelope; use fields:["result.id","result.name"]. Pass page.nextCursor in page.param within page.in, preserving the other arguments. Text/SQL reads take a string body.

path.description: Concrete path from search with ids filled in, e.g. /zones/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/dns_records. No query string.

method.description: GET by default; another method only for an operation search routes here.

body.description: Body for a reviewed read-only POST.

query.description: Query parameters as JSON, named as details lists them.

fields.description: Dot paths to keep in data. Envelope fields begin with result, e.g. ["result.id"] or ["result[].id"], where declared.

cf-r2-jurisdiction.description: R2 only: default, eu, us, fedramp, or fedramp-high, for a bucket outside the default jurisdiction.

data.description: Response body after value safety and the connection's privacy filtering.

param.description: Put nextCursor in this vendor parameter, unchanged.

tools.name: cloudflare_api_write
tools.description: Call a reviewed Cloudflare API write; method and path are stated for approval, and the operation index checks arguments first. Create, update or delete DNS records, purge cache URLs, deploy Workers and change KV/R2 state here. Reviewed uploads use cloudflare_api_upload; JSON, text/SQL and NDJSON writes retain their documented wire formats.

path.description: Concrete path from search with ids filled in, e.g. /zones/023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353/dns_records. No query string.

query.description: Query parameters as JSON, named as details lists them.

body.description: Request body as JSON fields, named as details lists them; form operations are encoded for you.

fields.description: Dot paths to keep in data. Envelope fields begin with result, e.g. ["result.id"] or ["result[].id"], where declared.

cf-r2-jurisdiction.description: R2 only: default, eu, us, fedramp, or fedramp-high, for a bucket outside the default jurisdiction.

data.description: Response body after value safety and the connection's privacy filtering.
